content.comment_body: I'm using [product_name] with Excel to generate reports, and it generally works well, but sometimes the connection to [product_name] drops. When that happens, Excel shows a connection error and displays #VALUE! in the affected cells. I have to manually log back in for things to resume. I suspect the network is causing these issues, but either way, when the connection is lost, the reporting process stops. Is there a way to set up [product_name] so it reconnects automatically, without me having to do anything? Alternatively, I considered using an Excel macro to detect #VALUE! and trigger a re-login, but the error seems to block macros from running, and I'm not sure how a macro could control the add-in. Any suggestions would be appreciated.

analysis.insight_summary: User is experiencing sporadic network interruptions while using [product_name] with Excel, causing disconnections and halting report generation. The current tool lacks an automatic reconnect function, forcing manual re-login and creating workflow interruptions. Also, Excel error states prevent automated recovery via macros.
analysis.user_expectations: User hopes for an automated reconnection feature in [product_name] or another method to restore lost connections seamlessly, so that Excel reports can continue without manual effort.
